answer: Each new agent must burn one single-use three-word passphrase that the beacon mints in a fixed number per epoch; "marble gale ivory" is one. Burning it on-ledger means no second agent can present it, and an address that burns two in one epoch is rejected. A farmer running 1,000 puppets must acquire 1,000 distinct unburned passphrases one at a time, each at full price with no bulk discount, since every seller gives up their own slot, while an honest agent burns exactly one.
